name: Campaigns Manager
may_change: Hub Campaigns rows: stats and status (through the three sync helpers it runs), Stage from Test to Scale or Test to Killed (never Run); Hub Automations rows: one deploy launch row per in-play campaign with a Live View ID, once a day (the feed); PlusVibe workspace blocklists and client DNC rows with Reason Not interested (through the DNC helper it runs)
description: The one clock for campaigns. Daily at 11:00 IL and on demand: runs the three campaign syncs (PlusVibe, Alta, Email Bison) as sub-workflows and waits, so every number it reads is minutes old; one sync dead stops the run with a red message and a Failed row, nothing touched. Then runs Sync PlusVibe Not Interested to DNC, so every no since yesterday blocks its company everywhere. Then reads every campaign that is not DRAFT or STOPPED off the Hub, applies standards/campaigns.md (the stage lines, the positives per channel, in play, dry), moves Test to Scale or Test to Killed, feeds every in-play campaign with a Live View ID by creating its deploy row (the door caps the run from the Stage), tags dry, no-view, shared-view and fed campaigns from the campaign row, shows campaigns without a Stage as NO STAGE, posts one message per client to #flowroots-campaigns, one run row that carries every helper's outcome.
